# Novaleo Weight & Wellness

> Novaleo Weight & Wellness is a telehealth functional medicine practice in Grand Rapids, Michigan, serving women in Michigan and Wisconsin. Founded by Kathryn Long, NP-C, a board-certified nurse practitioner with 20+ years of healthcare experience, Novaleo specializes in root-cause treatment for fatigue, brain fog, hormone imbalance, weight resistance, and metabolic dysfunction in professional women in their 40s and 50s.

## Services
- [Root Cause Assessment Call](https://novaweightandwellness.com/book-free-assessment-call): Free 10-minute consultation to determine next steps.
- [Root Cause Intake — 60-Minute Clarity Session](https://novaweightandwellness.com/clarity-session): $97 comprehensive clinical assessment.
- [Root Cause Lab Panel](https://novaweightandwellness.com/services): $454 signature biomarker panel including full thyroid, nutrients, inflammation, metabolic markers.
- [The Executive Longevity Partnership](https://novaweightandwellness.com/services): $3,995 six-month executive-level program limited to 4 clients.
- [Root Cause Follow-up](https://novaweightandwellness.com/services): 30–60 min follow-up for enrolled clients.

## Conditions Treated
- [Conditions We Treat](https://novaweightandwellness.com/what-we-treat): Persistent fatigue, brain fog, weight resistance, perimenopause & menopause, thyroid dysfunction, hormone imbalance, metabolic & insulin resistance, gut & digestive issues, sleep disruption, stress & burnout, autoimmune support, inflammation.

## About the Provider
- [About Kathryn Long, NP-C](https://novaweightandwellness.com/about): Board-certified nurse practitioner, certified in medical weight management, 20+ years in healthcare, specializing in hormones and metabolic health for women in midlife.

## How It Works
- [Our Approach](https://novaweightandwellness.com/approach): 4-step process — choose your starting point, root-cause review, personalized plan, guided support.

## Blog
- [Hot Flashes and Night Sweats: The Complete Guide for Michigan and Wisconsin Women](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/hot-flashes-night-sweats-women-michigan-wisconsin): Why hot flashes and night sweats happen, how long they last, how Michigan and Wisconsin seasons affect them, when night sweats are not menopause, and every treatment option graded by evidence, including CBT, clinical hypnosis, hormone therapy, and non-hormonal prescriptions.
- [Normal TSH But Still Exhausted](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/normal-tsh-hypothyroid-symptoms-michigan-wisconsin): Why standard thyroid tests fail women in their 30s and 40s, with full thyroid panels, T4 to T3 conversion, and Hashimoto's.
- [Medical Weight Loss and Hormone Therapy City Guide](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/medical-weight-loss-hormone-therapy-michigan-wisconsin-cities): How root-cause telehealth care reaches women in Grand Rapids, Detroit, Ann Arbor, Lansing, Kalamazoo, Milwaukee, Madison, Green Bay, and rural areas.
- [Perimenopausal Brain Fog vs. Something More Serious](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/perimenopause-brain-fog-memory-michigan-wisconsin): The hormonal science of memory and word-finding changes, and the warning signs that call for a different evaluation.
- [PCOS in Your 30s](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/pcos-weight-resistance-women-30s-michigan-wisconsin): Why weight loss feels impossible with PCOS and what actually helps.
- [Hormonal Sleep & Anxiety Guide](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/hormonal-sleep-anxiety-women-michigan-wisconsin): The hormonal reason behind sleepless nights and new anxiety.
- [Bioidentical Hormone Therapy Guide](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/bioidentical-hormone-therapy-guide-michigan-wisconsin): Risks, benefits, and what actually happens with BHRT.
- [Perimenopause in Your 30s](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/perimenopause-in-your-30s-michigan-wisconsin): Signs of early perimenopause women in their mid-30s often miss.
- [Why Ozempic Isn't Working](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/ozempic-not-working-michigan-wisconsin-women): A functional medicine perspective on the Ozempic weight-loss plateau.
- [Hormones & Weight Resistance Over 40](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-to-hormones-and-weight-resistance-over-40): The ultimate guide to hormonal weight resistance after 40.
- [Michigan Women Over 40](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/why-michigan-women-over-40-cant-lose-weight-feel-exhausted): Why Michigan women over 40 can't lose weight and feel exhausted.
- [Wisconsin Women Over 40](https://novaweightandwellness.com/blog/gaining-weight-exhausted-after-40-wisconsin-women): Gaining weight and exhausted after 40 — what Wisconsin women need to know.
